description: Adversarial constructed control explicitly engineering MVE items 5 and 7, which durable_findings.md §4 identifies as the only discriminating items.
method: Tokens emitted as PREFIX+STEM+SUFFIX. Two independent Markov chains over adjacent tokens — one on prefix identity, one on suffix identity — with tunable self-transition probabilities, which set prefix SC and suffix SC directly (item 5). Large heavy-tailed stem inventory yields mostly-unique full tokens (item 7). No linguistic content of any kind.
verdict: BOTH ITEMS SATISFIED. All 7 MVE checklist items are engineerable by a constructed system. The checklist does not discriminate encoded natural language from a sufficiently motivated constructed system.
